function fixNum(n) {
  return String(n)
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{7}/g, '$1.$2亿')
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{3}/g, '$1.$2万')
    .replace(/\.0([万亿])/g, '$1');
}

JSON.parse(String(result)).ranklist.map(o => {
  var subCateName = o.subCateName ? ' · ' + o.subCateName : '';
  var tags = [
    o.categoryName + subCateName,
    o.serialStatus == 0 ? '连载' : '完结'
  ];
  if (o.totalClick) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.totalClick) + '点击');
  }
  if (o.number) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.number) + '月票');
  }

  return {
    id: o.bookId,
    name: o.bookName,
    author: o.authorName,
    intro: o.description,
    kind: tags.join(','),
    last: o.updteChapterName,
    cover: 'http://static.zongheng.com/upload' + o.coverUrl,
    url: 'http://book.zongheng.com/book/' + o.bookId + '.html'
  };
});
</js>

  pos = Number($.chapter[i].pos);
  while(j>0 && $.page[j]>pos) {
    j--;
  }
  $.chapter[i].no = $.page[j]==0 ? "0" : "+"+$.page[j];
  $.chapter[i].page = "Page "+(j+1);
  $.chapter[i].next = [];
  j++;
  pos = Number($.chapter[i+1].pos);
  while($.page[j+1]<=pos) {
    $.chapter[i].next.push($.page[j]);
    j++;
  }
  i++;
}
$.chapter[i].no = "+"+$.page[j];
$.chapter[i].page = "Page "+(j+1);
$.chapter[i].next = [];
while(j<l) {
  $.chapter[i].next.push($.page[j]);
  j++;
}
var index = 0, list = [];
for (i=0; i<k; i++) {
  index = $.chapter.findIndex(it=>it.no==$.chapter[i].no);
  if (i==index) {
    list.push($.chapter[i]);
    j = list.length-1;
  } else {
    list[j].next = list[j].next.concat($.chapter[i].next);

}

    Packages.javax.crypto,

);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString("#txt@html");
    java.longToast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

<js>
(()=>{
	var v = String(source.getVariable())
	if(v.match(/^[1一壹qQ]$/)){
		url = "com.xiaoxiaobook.zuiread1"
	}else if(v.match(/^[2二贰wW]$/)){
		url = "com.diandianbook.androidreading1"
	}else{
		url = "com.ruffianhankin.meritreader1"
	}

	time = Math.round(new Date()/1000)
	sign = java.md5Encode(url+time+"vhjJVz1St6tK7!8n#B0MqRIuE2Dh7!C#")

	headers = JSON.stringify({
		"pt": "1",
		"time": String(time),
		"sign": String(sign),
		"package": String(url).replace(/1$/,''),
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 7_1_2 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/537.51.2 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/7.0 Mobile/11D167 Safari/9537.53"
	})
    return headers
})()
</js>

loginUrl:
<js>
// 工具类
var key = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("lXsAUe1NZEw6tAxM9w1Tpq2tU4la2+PwM8evj2C+yB0=")
var iv = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==")
var aes = Packages.cn.hutool.crypto.symmetric.AES("CBC","PKCS5Padding", key, iv)
var RandomUtil = Packages.cn.hutool.core.util.RandomUtil
// 参数
let userInfo = source.getLoginInfoMap()
let username = userInfo['手机号码/邮箱'].trim()
let password = userInfo['密码'].trim()
let app_version = "2.9.319"
let device_token = `ciweimao_`
let login_token = RandomUtil.randomString(32)
let account = `%E4%B9%A6%E5%AE%A2${RandomUtil.randomNumbers(12)}`
let uuid = `android${java.randomUUID()}`
var params = `app_version=${app_version}&device_token=${device_token}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}`
// 账号登录
function login(username, password){
  var loginUrl = `https://app.hbooker.com/signup/login?${params}&login_name=${username}&passwd=${password}`
  var autoRegUrl = `https://app.hbooker.com/signup/auto_reg_v2?oauth_union_id=&app_version=${app_version}&gender=1&oauth_open_id=&device_token=${device_token}&channel=vivo&oauth_type=&uuid=${uuid}`
// 是否游客
  let isLogin = !source.getLoginHeader()
  let isAuto = username == '' || password == ''
  if(isAuto && !isLogin){ 
     throw new Error("请勿重复登录,如若需要请清除登录头和Cookie")
  }
  var url = isAuto ? autoRegUrl : loginUrl
// 获取登录信息
  let res = JSON.parse(aes.decryptStr(java.ajax(url)))
  if(res.tip) {
    throw new Error(isAuto ? '当前为游客登陆，如有账号请自行登陆' : '账号登陆失败,请尝试切换网络或者等待几小时后重新登陆')
  }
  let login_token = res.data.login_token
  let user_code = res.data.user_code
  let reader_name = res.data.reader_info.reader_name
  let account = res.data.reader_info.account
  let rest_hlb = res.data.prop_info.rest_hlb
  java.toast(isAuto ? '自动登陆成功,若有账号请输入账号进行登陆' : `${reader_name}【剩余欢乐币:${rest_hlb}】,登录成功!`)
// 获取书架
  let bookList = java.ajax(`https://app.hbooker.com/bookshelf/get_shelf_list?app_version=${app_version}&device_token=${device_token}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}`)
  let shelf_list = JSON.parse(aes.decryptStr(bookList)).data.shelf_list[0]
  let shelf_id = shelf_list.shelf_id
  let reader_id = shelf_list.reader_id
// 登录完成
  let header = {
    "app_version": String(app_version),
    "device_token": String(device_token),
    "login_token": String(login_token),
    "account": encodeURIComponent(account),
    "user_code": String(user_code),
    "shelf_id": String(shelf_id),
    "reader_name": encodeURIComponent(reader_name),
    "reader_id": String(reader_id),
    "rest_hlb": String(rest_hlb)
  }
  return JSON.stringify(header)
}
// 写入登录头
header = login(username,password)
source.putLoginHeader(header)
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 解密
function decrypt(str1, str2){
  let key = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(java.digestBase64Str(str2,"sha256"))
  let iv = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==")
  let aes = Packages.cn.hutool.crypto.symmetric.AES("CBC","PKCS5Padding", key, iv)
  return aes.decryptStr(str1)
}
let headerMap = source.getLoginHeaderMap()
// 获取密钥
let app_version = headerMap['app_version']
let device_token = headerMap['device_token']
let account = headerMap['account']
let login_token = headerMap['login_token']
let rest_hlb = headerMap['rest_hlb']
let key = "zG2nSeEfSHfvTCHy5LCcqtBbQehKNLXn"
let cid = baseUrl.match(/chapter_id=(\d+)/)[1]
let result = JSON.parse(decrypt(result,key))
let tip = result.tip
if(tip){
 java.toast(tip)
 throw new Error(tip)	
}
let cmd = result.data.command
// 正文内容
let body = java.ajax(`https://app.hbooker.com/chapter/get_cpt_ifm?chapter_command=${cmd}&app_version=${app_version}&chapter_id=${cid}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}&device_token=${device_token}`)
let chInfo = JSON.parse(decrypt(body,key)).data.chapter_info
let unit_hlb = java.put('unit_hlb', chInfo.unit_hlb)
let content = decrypt(chInfo.txt_content,cmd)
let isPay = chInfo.is_paid && chInfo.auth_access == 0
let payText = `\n本章是VIP章节，购买后才能阅读\n本章需要${unit_hlb}币, 您有${rest_hlb}币,请点击右上角的购买按钮购买本章(请勿乱点)，购买后自动加入到个人书架！`
isPay ? content + payText : content 
</js>

// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

result;
</js>

  const source = "内暴强情缝贪插逼操潮喷阴艳裸乳荡穴鸡淫苞奸胸射嫩肉骚性蒂茎陰騷奶屄成人药春迷尿粉肛龟头A精屌口狂蜜处女唇道阳虐虫妇液色颜熟交爽臀爆舔做爱欲吹自慰点gG玉幼援抽Bb水母狗户部要了奴小脚痒酥死我兽揉搓捏扣抠棍棒洞密美少摩腿春乱伦露漏浪开巨根菊巴黑豪好肥送艳被干拔乱理白刺体下面诱感快货比日妈你娘婊子配仙火叫在里子宫给聊照流群屁眼马无码友拳洞片黄偷禁套弄位脱光舒服溜舞丢还糜妻换妓招嫖娼aA毛Hh一夜本热推图书娃男抓浑圆饱满润湿滑丰腴韵尤物横陈存娇喘息麻桃透风腹长粗肿胀人紧夹吸撅起来雪发翘硕大胴双草坐挲跨柔软臂瘫媚秘破"
  const replacementChars = source.split("")
  replacementChars[43]="AV"
  content = content.replace(/<i class="icon icon-uni(.{4})"><\/i>/g, (_, p1) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(p1, 16)));

  return Array.from(content, char => {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0)
    if (code >= 0xE001 && code <= 0xE101) {
      return replacementChars[code - 0xE001]
    } else {
      return char
    }
  }).join('')
}
replace(result)
</js>

  const replacementChars = source.split("")
  replacementChars[43]="AV"
  content = content.replace(/<i class="icon icon-uni(.{4})"><\/i>/g, (_, p1) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(p1, 16)));

  return Array.from(content, char => {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0)
    if (code >= 0xE001 && code <= 0xE101) {
      return replacementChars[code - 0xE001]
    } else {
      return char
    }
  }).join('')
}
replace(result)
</js>

    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);

      }

txt;

<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;

var document = JsDom.parse(src);

function getText(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().text() : "";
}

function getHref(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("href") : "";
}

function getSrc(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("src") : "";
}

function generateJsonList() {
    var jsonList = [];
    var uls = document.select(".mySearch ul").not(".pagination"); 

    uls.forEach(function(ul) {
        var prevDiv = ul.previousElementSibling(); 
        var imgSrc = prevDiv ? getSrc("img", prevDiv) : ""; 

        var item = {
            "img": imgSrc,
            "name": getText("li:eq(0) a.b", ul),
            "author": getText("li:eq(2)", ul),
            "wordcount": getText("li:eq(3)", ul),
            "lastchaptr": getText("li:eq(1) a", ul),
            "kind": getText("li:eq(4)", ul)+","+getText("li:eq(5)", ul),
            "url": getHref("li:eq(0) a.b", ul)
        };
        jsonList.push(item);
    });

    return jsonList;
}

result = generateJsonList();
String(java.log(JSON.stringify(result)));


</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 使用 Jsoup 解析 HTML 并定位正文内容节点
let documentObj = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
let contentContainer = documentObj.getElementById("BookText");

// 获取解密乱序内容所需的种子、校验值、属性名及偏移量
let seed = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-r"));
let totalCountKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-t"));
let attributeName = contentContainer.attr("data-a"); 
let offsetKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-k"));

// 计算应显示的有效段落总数并初始化存储容器
let actualParagraphCount = totalCountKey ^ (seed % 256);
let allParagraphs = contentContainer.select("p");
let validParagraphList = [];

// 遍历段落并还原真实的显示索引
for (let i = 0; i < allParagraphs.size(); i++) {
    let pElement = allParagraphs.get(i);
    let fingerprint = pElement.attr(attributeName);

    // 仅解密带有指纹属性的有效段落
    if (fingerprint) {
        let targetFingerprint = parseInt(fingerprint, 16);
        let recoveredIndex = -1;

        // 通过迭代匹配还原哈希算法混淆前的原始索引
        for (let idx = 0; idx < 1000; idx++) {
            let hashValue = (idx * 31 + offsetKey) >>> 0;
            hashValue = (hashValue ^ ((seed >> 3) & 0xFFFF)) >>> 0;
            
            // 模拟 32 位乘法溢出逻辑计算指纹
            let multiplier = 0x9e3779b1;
            let lowBits = (hashValue & 0xffff) * multiplier;
            let highBits = (hashValue >>> 16) * multiplier + (lowBits >>> 16);
            hashValue = (((highBits << 16) | (lowBits & 0xffff)) >>> 0) & 0xFFFFFF;

            // 匹配指纹成功后记录索引并中止循环
            if (hashValue === targetFingerprint) {
                recoveredIndex = idx;
                break;
            }
        }

        // 将索引合法的段落源码存入待排序数组
        if (recoveredIndex >= 0 && recoveredIndex < actualParagraphCount) {
            validParagraphList.push({
                htmlContent: pElement.outerHtml(),
                orderIndex: recoveredIndex
            });
        }
    }
}

// 清空结果变量并按照还原的索引顺序合并段落
result = "";
validParagraphList.sort((first, second) => first.orderIndex - second.orderIndex);
for (let j = 0; j < validParagraphList.length; j++) {
    result += validParagraphList[j].htmlContent + "\n";
}

result;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 从 baseUrl 中提取书籍 ID 和章节 ID
let aid = baseUrl.match(/book(?:s)?\/(\d+)/)[1];
let cid = baseUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/)[1];

// 直接发起请求获取包含校验变量的脚本内容并存储在 tokenScript 变量中
let tokenScript = java.ajax(`https://www.deqixs.co/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&referrer=${baseUrl}`);

// 从返回的脚本内容中通过正则提取所需的校验参数
let token = tokenScript.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];
let timestamp = tokenScript.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*(\d+)/)[1];
let nonce = tokenScript.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];

// 构造用于最终正文接口请求的参数字符串
let params = `aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&token=${token}&timestamp=${timestamp}&nonce=${nonce}`;

// 定义包含编码、来源页面和 User-Agent 的请求配置对象
let options = {
    "charset": "gbk",
    "headers": {
        "Referer": baseUrl,
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Android 7) Mobile",
        "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
    }
};

// 发起最终的异步请求并解析返回的 JSON 数据从中提取正文
result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php?${params},${JSON.stringify(options)}`)).data.content;
</js>
ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

// 批量清理官方广告及推广干扰语
let officialRules = [/更新不易.+?看最新章节！/g, /更新不易.+?看最新无错章节！/g, /更新不易.+?最新小说章节！/g, /速读谷/g, /速.读.谷/g, /速 读 谷/g, /本章节未完.+?请订阅/g];
officialRules.forEach(rule => result = result.replace(rule, ""));

result;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var bes = result.match(/PHA\+[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}/g);
//java.log(String(bes))
if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString("#txt@html");
    java.longToast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

💡默认删除作话的感谢投雷，如果显示了“作者有话要说”却没内容，就说明全是感谢投雷
💡正文默认不拼接评论，如需查看评论，请把另一个晋江源的正文规则粘贴过来

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

     Packages.java.lang,

    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}

// Error: org.mozilla.javascript.EcmaError: TypeError: Cannot find function body in object 
function () {...}. (<Unknown source>#35) in <Unknown source> at line number 35

1.修复关键词搜索，匹配多本杂志时导致的书籍列表规则异常报错【2021/05/13】
2.添加书籍URL正则【2021/06/10】
3.修复作者留空，书名都是类似《2021年06期》，这样导致的不同杂志相同期号被错误的识别为同一本书。暂时作者栏填写为杂志名。【2021/07/02】
4.修复img标签/data-action造成的图片无法显示【2021/07/08】
5.修改书名，增加杂志名作为前缀，方便排序整理书架，例如：“2021年06期”改为“《读者》 - 2021年06期”【2021/08/21】
6.优化算法，正文净化插入的随机字符串由正则表达式改为jsoup remove,减少了误杀img链接的情况，逻辑更加清晰，准确定位到元素比全文匹配效率高。【2021/09/17】
7.增加匹配条件，解决上一版未能净化的漏网之鱼【2021/10/03】
8.小标题和图片标注格式化，避免和正文混淆。【2021/10/26】

1.修复关键词搜索，匹配多本杂志时导致的书籍列表规则异常报错【2021/05/13】

4.修复img标签/data-action造成的图片无法显示【2021/07/08】

7.增加匹配条件，解决上一版未能净化的漏网之鱼【2021/10/03】

    // 如果 option 有内容，安卓阅读赋值为 32
    book.type = 32;
  } else if (genreValue === '1') {
    // 如果 genre 值为 1，安卓阅读赋值为 64
    book.type = 64;
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，安卓阅读赋值为 8
    book.type = 8;

    book.type = 2;
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，苹果源阅赋值为 0

  }
}

<js>//PHPSESSID每天刷新一次
(()=>{
		id = String(java.get('id'));
		time1 = parseInt(java.get('time'))+9E5;
		time2 = new Date().getTime();
if(/^\s*$/.test(id)||time1<time2){
		zi = '1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
		ra = () => Math.floor(Math.random()*36);
		id = zi.charAt(ra()+10);
		while(id.length<26)
				id = String(id+zi.charAt(ra()));
		java.put('id', id);
		java.put('time', time2);
	}
return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID="+id,
		"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
		"X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; ; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/96.0.4664.104 Mobile Safari/537.36"
	});
})()
</js>

  String(

      'https://m.zongheng.com/h5/ajax/search?h5=1&pageNum=1&field=all&pageCount=5&keywords=' +
        keyword
    )
  )
).searchlist.searchBooks;

var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));

var searchResults = J.select('.search-result-list').toArray();

searchBooks.map(o => {
  return {
    id: o.bookId,
    name: o.bookName,
    author: o.authorName,
    intro: o.description,
    kind: [
      o.serialStatus == 0 ? '连载' : '完结',
      String(
        J.select('.bookinfo a')
          .eq(1)
          .text()
      )
    ].join(','),
    last:
      o.updteChapterName + ' · ' +
      new Date(o.updateTime).toISOString().replace(/T.*/, ''),
    cover: 'http://static.zongheng.com/upload' + o.coverUrl,
    wordCount: String(
      J.select('.bookinfo span')
        .eq(1)
        .text()
    ),
    url:
      'http://book.zongheng.com/book/' +
      o.bookId + '.html'
  };
});
</js>

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
function fixNum(n) {
  return String(n)
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{7}/g, '$1.$2亿')
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{3}/g, '$1.$2万')
    .replace(/\.0([万亿])/g, '$1');
}

JSON.parse(String(result)).ranklist.map(o => {
  var subCateName = o.subCateName ? ' · ' + o.subCateName : '';
  var tags = [
    o.categoryName + subCateName,
    o.serialStatus == 0 ? '连载' : '完结'
  ];
  if (o.totalClick) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.totalClick) + '点击');
  }
  if (o.number) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.number) + '月票');
  }

  return {
    id: o.bookId,
    name: o.bookName,
    author: o.authorName,
    intro: o.description,
    kind: tags.join(','),
    last: o.updteChapterName,
    cover: 'http://static.zongheng.com/upload' + o.coverUrl,
    url: 'http://book.zongheng.com/book/' + o.bookId + '.html'
  };
});
</js>

ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 全局清理包含“苦读书”名称及网址的广告文本
result = result.replace(/\n?\(?苦读书\s+(www\.)?kudushu\.org\)?\s?/g, "");

// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

result;
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let free = source.getVariable() == "1"
let data = JSON.parse(result).data
let bid = baseUrl.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1]
let chapterList = []
data['vs'].forEach(list => {
  chapterList.push({
    name: String(list.vN),
    voltype: true
  })
  list['cs'].forEach(chapter => {
    let isVip = chapter.sS!="1" && !free ? "🔒":""
    let href = `https://vipreader.qidian.com/chapter/${bid}/${chapter.id}/`
    let url = list.hS == true || free ? `${href},{'webView': true}` : href
    chapterList.push({
      name: String(isVip+chapter.cN).trim().replace(/^(\d+)(?![\s\d卷部章节回.])/, '$1 ').replace(/\s+/g, " "),
      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})
chapterList

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
if (source.getLoginHeader() == null) {
    eval(String(source.loginUrl));
    login();
}
pi=baseUrl.match(/\/p\/d\/(\d+)/);
pi=pi?pi[1]:1
$ = java.getElements(".font-select@option");
n = 0; // 默认选择源
v = String(book.getVariable("custom"));
x = v.match(/^\d+$/) ? v : n;
x = parseInt(x) < $.length ? x : n;
java.toast(x);
// 提取书籍基本信息
name = java.getString('[property="og:novel:book_name"]@content');
author = java.getString('[property="og:novel:author"]@content');
kind = java.getString('[property~=category|status|update_time]@content');
last = java.getString('[property~=latest_chapter_name]@content');
img = java.getString('[property="og:image"]@content');
info = "  🌾简介："+ java.getString('[property="og:description"]@content');

// 多源情况处理
if ($.length > 1) {
    y = '\n📌使用说明：根据序号设置书籍变量来切换来源(默认0)。\n🎯当前源：序号🔺' + x + '🔻【' + $[x].text() + '】' + (x == 0 ? ' (默认)' : '');
    for (i in $) {
        y += '\n❤序号🔺' + i + '🔻【' + $[i].text() + '】\n源地址：'+`https://www.juxiaoshuo.net/post/novel/toc?novelId=${pi}&novelFromId=${$[i].attr("value")},{"method": "POST"}`;
    }
    info += y;
}
let bookUrlz = `https://www.juxiaoshuo.net/post/novel/toc?novelId=${pi}&novelFromId=${$[x].attr("value")},{"method": "POST"}`;
if (!name || !author || !kind || !last || !img || !info) {
    java.toast("⚠️书籍信息解析失败，可能是网络问题或网页链接不合法。请检查网页链接或稍后重试。");
}

data = {
    name: name,
    author: author,
    kind: kind,
    last: last,
    img: img,
    info: info,
    bookUrl: bookUrlz
};

// 序列化为JSON格式
JSON.stringify(data);
</js>

}

<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      c.updateTime = java.timeFormat(c.firstPassTime * 1000);
      c.info = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.updateTime;
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      if(variable.api != "" && variable.api != null && variable.api != undefined){
        c.url = variable.api.replace("{{item_id}}", c.itemId);
        c.isVip = false;
        c.isPay = false;
      } else {
        c.url  = `https://fanqienovel.com/api/reader/full?itemId=${c.itemId}`;
        c.isPay = c.isPaidStory || c.isPaidPublication;
        c.isVip = c.isChapterLock;
      }
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

let free = source.getVariable() == "1"
let data = JSON.parse(result).data
let bid = baseUrl.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1]
let chapterList = []
data['vs'].forEach(list => {
  chapterList.push({
    name: String(list.vN),
    voltype: true
  })
  list['cs'].forEach(chapter => {
    let isVip = chapter.sS!="1" && !free ? "🔒":""
    let href = `https://vipreader.qidian.com/chapter/${bid}/${chapter.id}/`
    let url = list.hS == true || free ? `${href},{'webView': true}` : href
    chapterList.push({
      name: String(isVip+chapter.cN).trim().replace(/^(\d+)(?![\s\d卷部章节回.])/, '$1 ').replace(/\s+/g, " "),
      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})

❗️注意事项:
1、请不要退出晋江app的账号，只要点了退出，或者在其他地方登录了，都要重新抓token。
2、更新token，书籍就要更新目录。
3、登录步骤：
①填写好账号密码，点击“邮箱验证码”或者“手机验证码”
②填写好验证码，点击“邮箱登录”或者“手机登录”
③点击右上角的“✓”，弹出提示“成功”
④想要确认是否成功可以在登录UI里点右上角三点，查看登录头token里是否有值。
4、如果邮箱和手机号无法登录，可能是需要过滑动验证码，可尝试先在晋江app里登录一遍后，再在阅读里登录，还是不行就只能抓包token，填写在“抓包token登录”处。
variableComment:
1、书籍变量（当前书）
填写 [去章节序号] —— 去除章节序号
填写[章节名]  ——  变为第xx章 章节名

填写 [目录简介【符号】] —— 章节简介放到目录列表，正文不出现 符号：跟章节名连接时中间的符号，如 目录简介【 】，中间将为空格

填写 [评论+评论数量]——如 评论50  则可以显示50条评论，数量必填

填写 [开启购买/关闭购买]  —— 如 开启购买 则会开启自动购买下五章【确认以后点右上角三点刷新才会生效，使用完毕后最好删除，避免重复请求】
